January 21, 1971
2014-11-22T00:01:34+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/january-21-1971-53724

Fifth day of 21-point demand. Students arranged a general meeting at Dhaka University Battala premises on the occasion. The meeting is chaired by East Pakistan Chhatra Union President Nurul Islam. Chhatra Union Dhaka town’s Organising Secretary Nizamuddin Azad, central Joint Secretary Abul Kashem, central Vice President Ayesha Khanam are among others who spoke in the occasion.

The speakers demanded immediate release of Moni Singh, held captive under security act, political leaders and workers, abolishment of legal framework order, demanded for formulation of a democratic governance policy and lifting the ban on communist party.
